Internal: the text route for a whole frame, when it needs one

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_frame_text_route.Rd

Five more messages offered the whole-frame jconvert(to = "stata" or "sas") that stops on a text variable with declared missing values (Session 352; the S351 item): joptions()'s workspace check, the convert-first remedy of the marker error a column of SPSS-style missing values gets, jrecode()'s ambiguous-missing stop and its marker refusal, and jdeclare_missing()'s note on a setting the variables do not use. Each asks this helper first: NULL when the plain call runs – a target that is not "stata" or "sas", or no declared string in the frame – else .jst_text_route()'s calls and sentence, the second call kept only when a variable of another form remains to convert.

Usage

.jst_frame_text_route(data, data_name, to, more_lines = FALSE)

Arguments

data

The data frame.

data_name

Its name, for the printed calls.

to

The conversion target.

more_lines

Passed to .jst_text_route().

Value

NULL, or the list .jst_text_route() returns.
